title: One row down the table: twenty million versus a trillion
takeaway: Big O is about growth: at a million items, moving from O(n log n) to O(n²) is the gap between a blink and not today.
sources: The row worth internalising is O(n log n) to O(n²).
At a million elements, that is twenty million operations versus a trillion: the difference between "finishes while you blink" and "does not finish today".
Almost every meaningful optimisation in an interview is moving between two adjacent rows of that table.
Big O notation describes how the work an algorithm does grows as its input grows.
